label: is-fix-37-42
topic: Fix open issues #37 to #42 of fractastical/delphi
summary: None of the six issues is fully resolved. All six are open with zero comments. #38 got a new recovery script, but every OpenAlex route returned HTTP 429 today, so 0 of the 93 missing works were recovered. #39 was only inspected, not changed. #37, #40, #41 and #42 each need one fact or decision from Amit. Nothing was posted and the repo was not edited. Files are in D:/Users/ashenoy00000/delphi-work/agents4/is-fix-37-42/ (RESOLUTIONS-37-42.txt, recover-missing-works.py, raw issue JSON). buehler-missing.json in that folder is an empty result from the rate-limited run and should not be merged.

lay_summary: The project has six open to-do notes, and I checked each one.
For one of them I wrote a small program to find 93 missing research papers, but the website that lists them said 'too many requests today', so it found none yet.
For another I looked at the project's web page and noted what is already there, but did not change it.
The other four cannot be finished by a computer because each needs one answer from the project lead, and I wrote down exactly which answer.
Nothing was posted online and the project's own files were left untouched.

glossary.issue: A to-do note on a project's public web page.
glossary.OpenAlex: A free online catalogue of research papers.
glossary.Crossref: Another free catalogue of research papers, run by publishers.
glossary.ORCID: A public ID number that a researcher uses so their papers can be told apart from others'.
glossary.HTTP 429: A website's reply meaning 'you have asked too many times, come back later'.
glossary.HTTP 404: A website's reply meaning 'that page or folder does not exist here'.
glossary.HTTP 403: A website's reply meaning 'you are not allowed to see this'.
glossary.cursor paging: Reading a long list in chunks, where each chunk hands you a bookmark for the next one.
glossary.corpus: The collection of papers the project has saved.
glossary.Lean: A computer program that checks mathematical proofs step by step.
glossary.rate limit / daily budget: The cap on how many questions a website will answer per day.
glossary.dropdown: A section of a web page that opens when you click it.
glossary.manuscript: The written draft of a research paper.
glossary.mailto: An email address sent along with a request to identify the sender.
